description.zh: 显示名称，用于页面显示，便于明确账号使用场景
description.en: The display name of the member. This helps clarify the scenario in which the account is used.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used as the member.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used as the management account.

description.zh:
支持修改的权限点如下：

- 允许同步信控身份给关联账号：SYNCHRONIZE\_FINANCE\_IDENTITY
- 允许同步优惠给关联账号：SYNCHRONIZE\_FINANCE\_DISCOUNT\_POLICY\_TO\_TARGET
- 禁止关联账户余额提现：FORBID\_WITHDRAW\_CASH
- 禁止关联账户管理发票：FORBID\_MANAGE\_INVOICE
- 请求查看财务关联信息：CHECK\_FINANCE\_INFO
- 允许管理目标发票：MANAGE\_TARGET\_INVOICE
- 允许查看关联账户消费信息：CHECK\_TARGET\_CONSUMPTION
description.en:
The permissions that can be modified. Valid values:

*   SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_IDENTITY: allows the credit control identity to be shared with the member.
*   SYNCHRONIZE_FINANCE_DISCOUNT_POLICY_TO_TARGET: allows the discount policy to be shared with the member.
*   FORBID_WITHDRAW_CASH: does not allow the member to withdraw the balance.
*   FORBID_MANAGE_INVOICE: does not allow the member to manage invoices.
*   CHECK_FINANCE_INFO: requests to view information about the financial relationship.
*   MANAGE_TARGET_INVOICE: allows the member to manage invoices.
*   CHECK_TARGET_CONSUMPTION: allows the member to view the bills.

description.zh: 关系ID。取值从QueryRelationList接口返回的结果字段relationId获取。
description.en: The ID of the financial relationship. Set this parameter to the value of the relationId response parameter returned by calling the QueryRelationList operation.

description.zh:
修改动作
- 添加：ADD
- 删除：DELETE
description.en:
The operation to be performed. Valid values:

*   ADD
*   DELETE
The type of the financial relationship. Set the value to enterprise_group.

description.zh: 请求唯一标识，用于标记一次请求，便于定位问题
description.en: The unique ID of the request. The ID is used to mark a request and troubleshoot a problem.
The roles that can be assigned to the member. You cannot modify the roles.
